scope: Grant-pause notification delivery and legacy social semantic ports
runtime: PostgreSQL17.11 disposable schemas; real local workerd

gates.suite: actual production API Maintenance factory empty-schema pass

behavior: System pause, workspace-scoped ledger and exact wake share one SQL transaction
Original provider key, encrypted body, recipient fingerprint,23-hour deadline and three-start ceiling survive retries and metadata restore
Plan loss can still notify a verified current authorized granter or Workspace owner
Renewal, expiry, recipient changes, epoch/generation changes and late ownership loss fence sends or settlement
Metadata restore returns zero product dispatch IDs; final redispatch registers future accepted due times
Daily grant authority pages use strict createdAt/id bounds, sorted parent locks and an actual partial index
Old Grant pause notice fields, notify/expiry scanners, global return helper and latest-grant inference helper removed
provider_email_delivery: not_run; send injected in tests per task restriction
